EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the 14th century.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! We must push the boundaries of what is possible. We must... we must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to describe his vision.

KING
(to the assembly)
We will replace our traditional suits of armor with... with... (he consults a parchment)...with neon-colored, PVC-encased exoskeletons. We will adorn our castles with... with... (he waves his hand)...with holographic projections of our ancestors.

ZORVATH
(stunned)
But, Your Majesty, what about the traditional heraldry? The coats of arms, the banners?

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... so... (he searches for the right word)...so last season. We will replace them with... with... (he grins mischievously)...with glitch art.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's vision begins to take shape. Knights in neon-colored exoskeletons ride by, their armor flashing with holographic projections of their ancestors. Castles are adorned with glitch art, their walls pulsing with a soft, blue light.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, is pleased with the progress.

KING
(to the assembly)
We are on the cusp of a new era, my friends. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of retro-futurism.

ZORVATH
(nodding)
Indeed, Your Majesty. We are pioneers in this new field.

KING
(smiling)
Then let us... let us... (he gestures grandly)...let us vaporwave our empire, and make it the most... the most... (he searches for the right word)...the most fabulous in all the land!

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a vibrant, pulsing entity, with knights in neon-colored exoskeletons riding by, their armor flashing with holographic projections of their ancestors. Castles are adorned with glitch art, their walls pulsing with a soft, blue light.

KING
(to the assembly)
We are the pioneers of a new era. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of vaporwave.

ZORVATH
(nodding)
Indeed, Your Majesty. We are the masters of our own destiny.

KING
(smiling)
Then let us... let us... (he gestures grandly)...let us vaporwave our empire, and make it the most... the most... (he searches for the right word)...the most fabulous in all the land!

FADE TO BLACK.
